issue_context.title: Google Cloud TTS supported languages Thai
issue_context.body:
Home Assistant release with the issue: 0.108.5
Last working Home Assistant release (if known):
Operating environment : raspberry pi 4
Component/platform:
https://www.home-assistant.io/components/google_cloud/

Description of problem:
Thailand language ('th-TH') is supported by Google Cloud, but not by the current Home Assistant platform.

Demo : https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/

Please fix it.
thank you
#welovehomeassistant
comments: Hey there @lufton, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`google_cloud`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L146) for? Thanks!
